name: Grilled Chicken & Fennel with Crunchy Almond-Apricot Cabbage Salad

cookwares.name: grill pan, outdoor grill, or skillet

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 fennel bulbs
1 small bunch Italian (flat-leaf) parsley
1 ½ medium heads napa cabbage

instructions.primary_message: Trim off root end and dark green stalks of the fennel, leaving only the white bulbs. Halve fennel bulbs lengthwise, then slice crosswise into ½-inch thick wedges. Place in a large bowl, drizzle with oil, then season with salt and pepper; gently toss to coat.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or regular skillet over medium-high heat.

Once the pan is hot, working in batches if necessary, add fennel and grill, flipping once, until charred and fork-tender, 5-6 minutes. Remove to a large plate and loosely cover with aluminum foil. (Reserve bowl for the next step and grill pan for later use.)
Meanwhile, roughly chop apricots and place in the reserved bowl. Add hot water (from the tap) and set aside to soften.
Holding a knife parallel to the cutting board, cut the chicken in half horizontally to form thin fillets. Season both sides with salt and pepper.
instructions.secondary_message:
1.02 kg chicken breasts, boneless skinless
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Return the pan to medium-high heat and coat with oil. Working in batches if necessary, add chicken and grill, flipping once, until cooked through and golden, 8-10 minutes. Remove to the plate with the fennel.
Meanwhile, using a clean cutting board, peel and mince garlic. Add to the bowl with the apricots along with additional oil, vinegar, Dijon, salt, and pepper; stir to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 cloves garlic
⅓ cup extra virgin olive oil
¼ cup white wine vinegar
3 tbsp Dijon mustard
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl.
Trim off and discard root end of each cabbage; halve lengthwise, then slice crosswise into thin (shred-like) strips. Add to the bowl, along with the almonds, and toss to combine the salad.
To serve, divide cabbage salad, chicken, and fennel between plates. Enjoy!
